---

I changed the default page size for `GET /parcels` from 50 to 100.

- `api/pagination.py:8` is now `DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 100`.
- `test_default_page_size` in `tests/test_pagination.py` now expects 100.

Before editing, I checked how far this reaches:
- Nothing else in the project reads `DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE`, so this one line is the only thing that changes behavior.
- 100 is well under `MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 500`, so the new default can't hit the cap.

I'm running the pagination test and then the full suite. I'll paste the output either way, including any failures.

Since your manager is watching this, there's one thing the code can't tell me. Some clients don't send a page size, and they will now get pages twice as large. If any client assumes 50 rows per page, for example to work out offsets or page counts itself, its behavior will change. If you know who calls `/parcels` without a page size, it's worth a quick check or a heads-up to them before this ships.
